description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the dblog module, including help text, menu alterations, cron cleanup, form modifications, and view pre-render adjustments.

classes.name: DblogHooks
classes.description: Class implementing hook functions for the Drupal dblog module, including help, menu, cron, form, and view hooks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help and overview information for the dblog module based on route name.

methods.name: menuLinksDiscoveredAlter
methods.description: Alters menu links to add a 'Top search phrases' link if the search module exists.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs cleanup of the watchdog log table based on configured row limit.

methods.name: formSystemLoggingSettingsAlter
methods.description: Alters the system logging settings form to add a log message limit selection.

methods.name: viewsPreRender
methods.description: Attaches the dblog library to views that display the watchdog table.
